title: GSK shares rise as $2.5B cost-cutting plan unveiled
snippet: As GSK records $2.4 billion in impairment charges for the second quarter, the U.K. pharma has announced a sweeping restructure designed to save about the same amount of money over the next few years.

title: Altimmune rises as GLP-1/glucagon drug curbs heavy drinking in mid-stage study
snippet: Pemvidutide showed a “highly statistically significant” treatment effect in patients with alcohol use disorder. Altimmune is going up against Eli Lilly and newcomer Baseline Therapeutics, among others, in this space.
